messages:
Priya: Heads up — Kenji (SWE) is flying in from NRT, arriving 10:45pm Tues. He asked if we can arrange airport shuttle or taxi + an overnight hotel booked on company card. cc @Maya @TravelOps
Maya: We can book one night at our partner hotel and cover taxi shuttle. TravelOps, can you confirm hotel availability and provide pickup instructions for late arrival? Also Kenji noted he needs a Kinesis-style quiet keyboard (low profile) and low-fragrance env.
TravelOps: Confirmed — partner hotel has a late check-in option. We'll book room under corporate rate and schedule a taxi pickup at arrivals. Will leave a printed voucher at reception. Need candidate phone and passport name to proceed.
Priya: DM'd phone + passport name to Maya. Also Kenji requested a sign-language interpreter for part of the onsite due to hearing support needs. Is that doable?
Maya: Yes — we have a roster for on-site interpreters. I can book a 2-hour slot starting at the coding session. Will add host-only notes for front desk and interpreter arrival instructions.
Facilities: For the interview room, suggest Room 4-2 (larger table + monitor) to seat interpreter and panel comfortably. We'll reserve 2 chairs set back for the interpreter and print a "Quiet interview" sign. Also added a power strip and a USB-C to HDMI adapter.
IT Support: We can prepare a loaner MacBook image and the adapter, plus the low-profile keyboard. Need a signed equipment form at pickup. Will stage `redwood-intv-mac-12` with sample creds.
Maya: Noting reimbursement policy: meals and taxi covered up to $150. If candidate needs per diem beyond that, we need pre-approval. TravelOps will email the voucher and expense instructions. Candidate must submit receipts within 14 days.
Priya: Kenji also asked whether he can do the whiteboard exercise on paper — prefers less noise. Nish (hiring manager) okay with that?
Priya: Nish said paper + marker is fine; panel will rate equivalently. We'll provide a large pad and an extra marker.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Kenji — SWE onsite (late arrival)" with Zoom fallback. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/ghi789
Maya: I'll add host-only notes: interpreter arrival time, hotel voucher pickup, driver phone number, door code, and accommodation for low-fragrance cleaning. Door code for host-only: `11#77`
TravelOps: Voucher printed and left at reception. Taxi contact: +1-555-0199, company code RED-TRAVL. Hotel confirmation number: H-9921 (host-only).
Priya: I'll confirm ETA morning of with Kenji and remind him about the receptionist voucher pickup. Thanks all.
Maya: Done — invites updated, interpreter booked, loaner reserved. Facilities to put up sign.
Facilities: Sign printed and placed. We'll have someone at reception to assist with escort to 4F.
Priya: Great — closing loop. I'll follow up post-interview with expense submission note. :pray:
